_comment: Landmark ground truth from 'Files Description & Ground-truth Measurements.pdf' (Zenodo 5116478). Reference distance chosen BEFORE any clicking/errors: mag_height (A4 long side). Values in mm are quoted from the PDF; A4 is the PDF's stated nominal size ('Not measured, A4 size: 210 x 297mm').

points.name: mag_TL
points.description: TOP-LEFT corner of the printed 'THE AGE OF JIHAD' magazine cover pinned on the TV-wall noticeboard (outer corner of the page, not the title box). Skip an image (n) if the corner is hidden by a neighbouring cover.

points.name: mag_TR
points.description: TOP-RIGHT corner of the same 'THE AGE OF JIHAD' cover (outer page corner).

points.name: mag_BL
points.description: BOTTOM-LEFT corner of the same cover (outer page corner). It may be hidden behind the magazine below it; skip if so.

points.name: shoe_toe
points.description: Tip of the toe of the shoe. Use the mannequin's own LEFT foot (the shoe on the same side as the bloody handprint paper and marker 1415, with dried dirt visible on the sole). Left/right in the frame varies by image; in IMG_0461 it is the LEFT shoe as shown. Skip images where the toe tip is not clearly visible.

points.name: shoe_heel
points.description: Rearmost point of the heel of the SAME shoe as shoe_toe. Use the mannequin's own LEFT foot (the shoe on the same side as the bloody handprint paper and marker 1415, with dried dirt visible on the sole). Left/right in the frame varies by image; in IMG_0461 it is the LEFT shoe as shown.

points.name: lip_L
points.description: One corner of the mannequin's mouth (the end of the lips, the left of the two corners as you see it in IMG_0464).

points.name: lip_R
points.description: The OTHER corner of the mouth (the end of the lips).

points.name: box_A
points.description: A TOP-face corner of the small paper box lying with the bomb tools (near the yellow tape roll).

points.name: box_B
points.description: The top-face corner reached from box_A along the box's LONG edge (PDF length 95.32 mm).

points.name: box_C
points.description: The top-face corner reached from box_A along the box's SHORT edge (PDF width 60.79 mm).

points.name: button_L
points.description: OPTIONAL (low precision, ~25 px): left edge of one shirt button (diameter 11.75 mm); use the same button in all images.

points.name: button_R
points.description: OPTIONAL: right edge of the SAME shirt button, on the line through its centre.
